integrity: Analytic proof with explicit genealogy formula and heat-kernel estimates; finite exact-rational and numerical checker is supplemental, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Unconditional site-count covariances only, finite positive offspring variance and the five-point symmetric lazy step law; no survival-conditioned multi-site limit, convergence-rate estimate, or exhaustive historical-priority claim.
title: Logarithmic spatial correlations in planar critical branching random walks
